title: When, and If
label: ch:ml-when-if
canDo: I can ask when something will happen, say when one thing happens relative to another, and set a condition.

payoff.summary: From cold: the question word for time built out of the now/then pair, the -umbol ending that fixes one event against another, and the -aal ending that leaves it conditional — plus which tense form each one is built on.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. No new verb is added: every sentence is built from varuka and pokuka, and the pronouns come from chapter 71.
